hosting.//: Serves /privacy-policy from privacy-policy.html. Without it the catch-all rewrite below swallows both static pages and returns the app instead, which is worse than a 404 because it still answers 200.

headers.//: Every HTML entry point, including / and the SPA routes rewritten to it. Headers match the REQUEST path, so /index.html alone does not cover / or /tools-services. A cached shell keeps requesting an old content-hashed bundle, which is what pinned the site to the first build.
Overrides the rule above. Built assets carry a content hash, so a new build is a new URL and these can be cached forever.
Crop and equipment photos keep stable filenames, so a day rather than forever - replacing one still reaches people quickly.
